scripts.gen:api: cd .. && ${PYTHON:-python3} -m api.export_openapi > web/openapi.json && cd web && openapi-typescript openapi.json -o src/lib/api-schema.d.ts
scripts.check:api: cd .. && ${PYTHON:-python3} -m api.export_openapi | diff -q - web/openapi.json && cd web && openapi-typescript openapi.json -o /tmp/plantvision-api-check.d.ts && diff -q /tmp/plantvision-api-check.d.ts src/lib/api-schema.d.ts && echo 'API types match the FastAPI schema'
